_README: Provenance for a vendored upstream kernel tree (kernel-ownership.md 1, 4, 5.4).
`upstream` cites the exact artefact the copy was taken from (distribution, version, commit, repo).
`rewrite_rules` are the ONLY edits applied, as ordered literal substitutions, plus `header_template`
prepended to every file. `upstream_sha256` records the upstream file the copy was taken from, as
citation; it is not compared with an installed package. The tree was qualified for determinism when
`vendored_sha256` is the tamper check on OUR copy (ops/gdn/shared/tests/test_vendored_provenance_cpu.py),
and needs no runtime installed to run. Owner: see `upstream.owner`.
header_template:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VENDORED KERNEL -- DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
# upstream_module: {module}
# upstream_dist:   vllm {version}  (scm {scm}, commit {commit})
# upstream_url:    {repo} (Apache-2.0; see NOTICE)
# provenance:      {provenance}
# local changes:   only the rewrite_rules recorded in PROVENANCE.json; vendored_sha256 pins this file.
# why vendored:    kernel-ownership.md 1 -- this kernel DETERMINES a rounding schedule the
#                  IsoExec arithmetic contract pins, and its upstream is an internal module of a
#                  fast-moving project with no API-stability contract. Test 2 says: vendor it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rewrite_rules: from vllm.triton_utils import tl, tldevice, triton
